AGENDA
  GLENDALE ARTS AND CULTURE COMMISSION
  VIA TELECONFERENCE ONLY
 Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
 verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the city's webpage,
 glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire devices
 using a free app called Screenweave and choosing “Glendale TV” from the menu. Meetings are also
 archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas. Call (818) 548-4013 for
 program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City Clerk's Office.
 If you have any question about matters on the agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the
 Library, Arts and Culture Department, at (818) 548-2030, during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
 In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
 language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
 are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for
 requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents related
 to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this meeting, and
 are public records, will be available for review in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E. Broadway, RM
 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
 Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
 wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
 Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify
 the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City provided interpreters is not
 required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.
  NOVEMBER 18, 2021 AT 2:00 PM

To help slow the transmission of COVID-19, and protect the health and safety of the community, City
Council, as well as Board & Commission meetings, will continue to be closed to the public for in-person
attendance.
The public is encouraged to watch and participate from the safety of their homes to practice social
distancing. Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and
AT&T U-verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the city's webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire devices
using a free app called Screenweave and choosing “Glendale TV” from the menu.
For public comments and questions during the meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a
specific agenda item will be taken when that agenda item is discussed.

  1. REGULAR BUSINESS AGENDA – 2:00 PM
   Roll Call
  a. Report of Recorder, re: Posting of Agenda. The Agenda for the November 18, 2021
  Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission was Posted on
  November 10, 2021 on the Bulletin Board Outside City Hall.
2. CONSENT ITEMS (Including Minutes)
  The following are routine and may be acted upon by one motion. Any member of the
  Commission or the audience requesting separate consideration may do so by making such
  request before motion is proposed.
  a. Minutes of the October 21, 2021 Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture
  Commission
3. INTRODUCTIONS AND PRESENTATIONS
  a. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Jennifer Fukutomi-Jones, Principal

  Arts & Culture Administrator

4. ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Discussion is limited to Items NOT a Part of this Agenda. Each Speaker is Allowed 5 Minutes.
  Members of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission may Question or Respond to the
  Speaker, but there will be no Debate or Decision. The Matter may be Referred to Staff
  Through the Commission Chair for Investigation and Report.
5. ACTION ITEMS
  a. Art Happens Anywhere – “Ride Like the Wind” Proposed Budget Increase

  1. Motion approving an increase in the Art Happens Anywhere (AHA) Program budget of
  artist Cathy Hrenda, from $8,000 to $15,000 from the 2021-2022 Work Plan, to enable
  her to pay for additional costs associated with purchasing steel for the structure and the
  installation of a steel plate foundation.
  b. Artsakh Creative Pilot Program

  1. Motion appointing one Commissioner to serve on the Artsakh Creative Pilot Program
  Application Review Panel as a representative of the Commission.
6. DISCUSSION ITEMS
  a. 2021-2022 Work Plan Progress Updates
  1. CITY-WIDE ARTS
  i. Art Happens Anywhere – Projects Update
  ii. LeBasse Projects – RFQ Update
  iii. Mural Ordinance - Community Input Meeting Update
  iv. The Aspire Group – Update
  2. NEIGHBORHOOD ARTS
  i. Storefront Art Pilot Program – Update
  3. PERFORMING ARTS – No Update
  4. ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS – No Update
  5. MARKETING AND COMMUNICATIONS – Update
7. COMMISSION/STAFF COMMENTS
8. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS
 9. ADJOURNMENT
  The next Regular Meeting of the Glendale Arts and Culture Commission is Thursday,
  December 16, 2021, at 2:00 PM via teleconference only.

CITY OF GLENDALE
  ARTS and CULTURE COMMISSION
  Minutes of Regular Meeting

  Thursday, November 18, 2021 at 2:00 p.m.
1.  ROLL CALL
  •  The meeting was called to order on November 18, 2021 at 2:09 p.m.
  •  Present: Commissioner Viar, Vidor, Vice Chair Yank, Chairperson Tufenkian
  •  Absent: Commissioner Zadorian
  •  The Agenda for the November 18, 2021 Regular Meeting was posted on November 10, 2021 on the
  Bulletin Board outside City Hall.

2.  CONSENT ITEMS (INCLUDING MINUTES)
  a. Minutes of the October 21, 2021 Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission
  Moved:  Commissioner Viar
  Seconded: Commissioner Vidor

  Ayes:  Commissioners Viar, Vidor, Vice-Chair Yank, Chairperson Tufenkian
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Abstain:  None

3.  INTRODUCTIONS & PRESENTATIONS
  a. Library, Arts & Culture Events – Presented by Jennifer Fukutomi-Jones, Arts and Culture Commission
  Administrator.
  • Ms. Fukutomi-Jones gave an overview of current and upcoming events at Glendale Library, Arts
  & Culture locations.

4.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
  Speaker(s): None

5.  ACTION ITEMS

  a. Art Happens Anywhere – “Ride Like the Wind” Proposed Budget Increase
  1. Motion approving an increase in the Art Happens Anywhere (AHA) Program budget of artist Cathy
  Hrenda, from $8,000 to $15,000 from the 2021-2022 Work Plan, to enable her to pay for additional
  costs associated with purchasing steel for the structure and the installation of a steel plate
  foundation.

  Moved:  Commissioner Viar
  Seconded: Vice Chair Yank

  That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby approves an increase in the Art Happens Anywhere
  (AHA) Program budget of artist Cathy Hrenda, from $8,000 to $15,000 from the 2021-2022 Work
  Plan, to enable her to pay for additional costs associated with purchasing steel for the structure and

  1
   the installation of a steel plate foundation, as more fully outlined in the November 18, 2021 Report
  by the Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture Administrator.

  Ayes:  Commissioners Viar, Vice Chair Yank, Chairperson Tufenkian
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Abstain:  Commissioner Vidor

  b. Artsakh Creative Pilot Program

  1. Motion appointing one Commissioner to serve on the Artsakh Creative Pilot Program Application
  Review Panel as a representative of the Commission.
  Moved:  Commissioner Vidor
  Seconded: Vice Chair Yank

  That the Arts and Culture Commission hereby appoints Commissioner Viar to serve on the Artsakh
  Creative Pilot Program Application Review Panel, as more fully outlined in the November 18,
  2021 Report by the Library, Arts & Culture’s Principal Arts & Culture

  Ayes:  Commissioners Viar, Vidor, Vice Chair Yank, Chairperson Tufenkian
  Noes:  None
  Absent:  Commissioner Zadorian
  Abstain:  None

6. DISCUSSION ITEMS

  a. 2021-2022 Work Plan Progress Updates
  1. CITY-WIDE ARTS
  i. Art Happens Anywhere – Projects Update
  a. Ms. Fukutomi-Jones provided updates on the AHA projects. The Commission asked
  questions and gave their feedback.
  ii. LeBasse Projects – RFQ Update
  a. Ms. Fukutomi-Jones provided an update on the RFQ applications. The Commission asked
  questions and gave their feedback.

  iii. Mural Ordinance - Community Input Meeting Update
  a. Ms. Fukutomi-Jones stated that the community meeting will be held in November via
  teleconference. Feedback and community input was shared at the Commission’s November
  18, 2021 Regular Meeting.

  iv. The Aspire Group – Update
  a. Ms. Fukutomi-Jones provided updates on the Aspire Group. The Commission asked
  questions and gave their feedback.

  2. NEIGHBORHOOD ARTS – No Update
  3. PERFORMING ARTS – No Update
  4. ARTS AND CULTURAL EVENTS – No Update
  5. MARKETING AND COMMUNICATIONS – Update
  a. Staff is drafting an RFQ for a PR Firm. Staff will provide an update on the draft RFQ at the next
  Commission Regular Meeting.

  2
 7. COMMISSION / STAFF COMMENTS
 • Commission thanked Staff and Vice Chair Yank for their efforts with the City Wide Public Art RFQ.

8. WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS - None

9. ADJOURNMENT – 2:41 pm

The next Regular Meeting of the Arts and Culture Commission is January 20, 2022, at 2:00 p.m., via
teleconference.
